name: Afterhours
direction_summary: Near-black club UI with one acid-lime accent. Full-screen silent product video opens the store, product names sit over the image on overlay cards, and the product page splits into a sticky buy panel beside cinematic media. Feels like a rave ticket, not generic luxury.

typography.note: Confirm both in Shopify font library at build time

tokens.shadows: none; depth via borders and surface color

sections.name: Main product (sticky split)
sections.responsive: mobile: media carousel + bottom buy bar

image_brief.style_line: Night-time streetwear editorial: deep black background, hard flash photography, acid lime (#C6FF3D) rim light accents, gritty film grain, high contrast, Europe/US Gen-Z street style. No text, no logos, no watermark, no recognizable real people.
